card.name: Digits in number sequences and ratios
card.fires_on: A single digit (often 1, 2, 3) that sits inside a run of digits or a ratio, such as 2-1-1, 1:1:1 or a countdown. It is usually a later item in the series.

modes.label: Ratios
modes.description: The last digit in a hyphen- or colon-separated ratio.

modes.label: Countdowns and number lists
modes.description: A digit in a descending count or a row of numbers or table values.

card.plain: It fires on a digit in the middle or end of a series of numbers, such as a ratio or a countdown.
